glossary: MoFPI
Ministry of Food Processing Industries, the target organization.
ESG
Environmental, Social and Governance: a framework for measuring sustainability impact.
CNN
Convolutional Neural Network, a model type for image analysis.
MAPE
Mean Absolute Percentage Error: average forecast error as a percentage.
OTP
One-Time Password used to confirm delivery to the recipient.
Haversine Formula
Computes straight-line distance between two latitude/longitude points.
XGBoost
Gradient-boosted decision tree library for tabular prediction.
PostGIS
PostgreSQL extension for geospatial data and queries.
OSRM
Open Source Routing Machine, a road-network routing engine.
RBAC
Role-Based Access Control: permissions granted by user role.
JWT
JSON Web Token used for stateless authentication.
PWA
Progressive Web App: a web app installable like a native app.
NGO
Non-Governmental Organization, here a verified food-receiving community organization.
refs: React, Node.js, Express, FastAPI, PostgreSQL / PostGIS
XGBoost, Random Forest, MobileNetV2, transfer learning
